name: Vamp
subtitle: Private Mac companions for iPhone and iPad
description: Official AltStore source for Vamp Assistant and Vamp Stream.

apps.name: Vamp Assistant
apps.subtitle: Control your trusted Mac and continue Assistant sessions remotely.
apps.localizedDescription: Pair with Vamp Assistant on your Mac to continue sessions, approve requests, exchange files, stream and control the Mac, and securely unlock it through Tailscale.

versions.localizedDescription: Makes secure Mac unlock complete at the physical login window and adds richer remote settings, model selection, bot console, approval previews, and stream recovery.
Adds visible version and build information plus the secure Tailscale-only Mac unlock flow.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant scans the one-time pairing QR code shown by your Mac.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant connects to Vamp Assistant running on your trusted Mac.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant can dictate text onto your Mac from the Control keyboard.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Vamp Assistant turns on-device speech into keystrokes on your Mac.

apps.name: Vamp Stream
apps.subtitle: Focused visual control for a trusted Mac.
apps.localizedDescription: Stream a Mac display or individual app window from Vamp Sync, Vamp Host, or Vamp Assistant over a trusted LAN or private Tailscale network.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds the authenticated Mac-password unlock form for Vamp Assistant and recognizes the Remote Unlock policy exposed by Vamp Sync.
Previous sideloadable iPhone and iPad release.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses the camera to scan the private Vamp Assistant pairing QR code.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Vamp Stream uses your local network to discover and connect to Macs running Vamp Sync, Vamp Host, or Vamp Assistant.

news.title: Vamp Assistant 0.1.35
news.caption: Remote unlock now completes at the Mac login window, with expanded native remote controls.

news.title: Vamp Stream 0.1.2
news.caption: Unlock a connected Vamp Assistant Mac securely and resume streaming without local access.
